public_sources.title: E-backtesting
public_sources.authors: Qiuqi Wang; Ruodu Wang; Johanna Ziegel
public_sources.used_scope: Predictable betting preserves e-process validity while power depends on the alternative model; the paper explicitly discusses mixtures/mixture martingales over alternative scenarios when the conditional alternative distribution is unknown.

public_sources.title: Safe testing
public_sources.authors: Peter Grunwald; Rianne de Heide; Wouter Koolen
public_sources.used_scope: Provides the conditional-e-variable/product basis for choosing fresh-stage testing strategy from information available before the next genuinely fresh observation.

public_sources.title: Strong duality for the GROW criterion
public_sources.authors: Ashwin Ram; Martin Larsson; Johannes Ruf; Aaditya Ramdas
public_sources.used_scope: Recent general optimality theory for betting/e-variables against composite alternatives. Used only as motivation that alternative uncertainty should be treated as an explicit decision problem; the worker-local finite-mixture construction below has a direct conditional-expectation proof.

preaudit_weighted_alternative_mixture.setup: After development data D select/freeze a candidate. Let q_j in {0.50,0.60,0.65,0.70,0.75,0.80}. For each q_j build the paired-sign fresh e-process E_{j,t} with discordant factors 2q_j and 2(1-q_j); q=.50 is the constant-one component.
preaudit_weighted_alternative_mixture.weights: Choose nonnegative weights w_j(D) summing to one using only frozen pre-audit information. A simple worker-local choice uses decomposed predictor p_hat(D): weight 1-p_hat on q=.50 and distribute p_hat across q=.60-.80 according to a validation-independent prior.
preaudit_weighted_alternative_mixture.mixture: M_t=sum_j w_j(D) E_{j,t}. Conditional on D, every component is an e-process under the selected-candidate sign null and the weights are fixed before fresh outcomes, so M_t is an e-process. The mixture can be viewed as implicit posterior updating: component wealth reweights the next predictive sign bet after each fresh result.
preaudit_weighted_alternative_mixture.scope_guard: Weights may depend on frozen development information but not on the fresh outcome they are about to weight. Alternative prior misspecification changes growth/power, not null validity.

aggressive_robust_process_blend.construction: Let E^75_t be the aggressive fixed-q=.75 fresh e-process and M_t the pre-audit alternative mixture. For protocol-fixed a, H_t=a E^75_t+(1-a)M_t is an e-process conditional on D.
aggressive_robust_process_blend.purpose: This is not post-hoc evidence weighting. It is a predeclared mixture of two fresh conditional e-processes, used to trade short-horizon aggressiveness against alternative-strength robustness and false/harmful commits.
aggressive_robust_process_blend.scope_guard: Choosing a after looking at the current fresh evidence is not covered. Tune a from disjoint meta-data or predeclare a finite family with a separate safe aggregation rule.

worker_local_simulation.base_selection: Independent 40k selected-candidate trajectories from the prior full adaptive proposal-loop; decomposed pre-audit predictor trained on a separate 120k meta-run. Fresh grid q_good=.60-.80, rho=.2/.4/.6, budgets 20/50/100/200.

preaudit_q_mixture.good_strength_prior: Uniform over q in {.60,.65,.70,.75,.80}; q=.50 weight is 1-p_hat_decomp and the good-strength mixture gets total weight p_hat_decomp.
preaudit_q_mixture.comparison: The point decomp bet from the immediately prior checkpoint had B200 true/false 0.310170/0.001637, so alternative-strength mixing recovered about 0.58 percentage points of true commits at essentially the same very low false-commit level.

fixed_plus_mixture_blend_grid.definition: a is the fixed weight on E^75; 1-a is the weight on the pre-audit q-mixture.
fixed_plus_mixture_blend_grid.interpretation: At B200, a=.25 retained essentially all aggregate true resolution of fixed .75 while cutting harmful/false commits by about 69%; larger a recovered audit speed but moved back toward fixed-bet false-commit behavior. This is a finite-grid Pareto observation, not a universal optimal weight.

null_sanity_60k.interpretation: All below alpha=.05; conditional mixture proof is the validity argument and Monte Carlo only checks implementation.

severe_transfer_misspecification.scenario: For genuinely-good selected candidates set fresh q approximately 0.51+0.28*(1-p_hat_decomp), deliberately making the pre-audit predictor most aggressive where fresh transfer is weakest; rho=.4.
severe_transfer_misspecification.interpretation: The robust mixture did not erase severe transfer shift: it traded substantial false-commit reduction for lower resolution. A predeclared aggressive-process blend approached fixed-bet power as its fixed weight increased. Misspecification remains a power/utility problem even though null validity is preserved.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Use frozen pre-audit features to allocate a prior over several fresh effect strengths, including a q=.5 no-effect component, then let fresh component wealth update the mixture predictably.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Direct conditional mixture-e-process proof; E-backtesting mixture guidance; worker-local grid recovered power over a point predictor at nearly unchanged low false-commit rate.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope_guard: Current q grid/prior are illustrative; alternative support and weights require validation-independent tuning.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Predeclare a fixed convex mixture between an aggressive fixed-q fresh e-process and a pre-audit robust alternative-mixture e-process. Use the weight as an explicit finite-horizon risk/power knob rather than post-hoc choosing the stronger process.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: At B200, fixed weight .25 on q=.75 retained aggregate true resolution within about 0.08 percentage points of fixed-only while reducing harmful/false commits from .02165 to .00673 in the worker-local grid.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope_guard: No claim that .25 is optimal outside this simulator or horizon.

rejected_or_narrowed_generalizations: Rejected: 'a single pre-audit point estimate of fresh effect is sufficient once its null validity is safe.' A mixture over plausible effect strengths recovered finite-horizon true resolution at essentially the same low false-commit level in the tested grid.

Narrowed: 'mixture betting solves alternative misspecification.' Severe inverted transfer still reduced power materially; mixture betting hedges model uncertainty but cannot create signal that does not transfer.

Rejected: 'after seeing which fresh e-process is larger, choose it.' The safe construction uses protocol-fixed weights or a separately proven predictable/portfolio rule; post-hoc max/weighting is not free.

frontier.action: Replace fixed pre-audit alternative weights with a hierarchical model that puts validation-independent uncertainty over transfer calibration itself, and compare Bayes-mixture, minimax/regret mixture and fixed aggressive blend under q drift and feature-effect inversion.

Add shared-task difficulty and cross-candidate/task dependence. Construct fresh one-step factors from conditional sign statements given task covariates; verify that side-information predictors do not accidentally consume fresh-task labels before the bet is fixed.

Move reused-development candidate evaluation from fixed-horizon e-values to actual anytime PACE paths. Explicitly include stopping time/supremum in the selectable transcript and test adjuster/selection corrections.

Extend from one accepted candidate to repeated modification streams; compare run-level alpha spending, e-closed testing and recent e-process multiple-testing adjusters while keeping candidate-generation data adaptivity separate.

Measure finite-horizon utility with asymmetric cost for harmful commits, unresolved decisions and fresh audit tasks; select mixture/blend weights only on disjoint meta-runs and report the full Pareto surface rather than one scalar optimum.

exact_next_action: Introduce validation-independent uncertainty over the preaudit-feature-to-fresh-effect transfer map, then stress Bayes-mixture/minimax-regret fresh betting under shared-task heterogeneity before replacing reused fixed-horizon selection with actual PACE stopping/supremum transcripts.
